name: ai-pharmacist-hackathon
description: Agentic AI system for autonomous digital pharmacy This project is an AI-driven pharmacist that supports natural voice/text ordering, enforces medicine and prescription safety, predicts individual refill needs, and autonomously drives backend operations with minimal human intervention. ## Core Features - **Conversational Ordering:** Supports natural text and voice conversations to extract medicine names, dosages, and quantities. - **Safety & Policy Enforcement:** Automatically checks prescriptions and stock levels before processing orders. - **Predictive Intelligence:** Proactively predicts when patients need refills using historical data. - **Real-world Action:** Triggers backend actions such as inventory updates, webhooks, and notifications. - **Observability & Trace Logs:** Tracks all agent decisions and interactions for audit purposes. ## Add-ons - **User Accounts:** Sign up / login system with password hashing. - **Multilingual Support:** Chat supports multiple languages using i18next. - **Voice Input & Output:** Conversational interface supports speech recognition and text-to-speech. - **Proactive Refill Alerts:** Users get notifications automatically before they run out of medicine. - **CSV Input:** Medicine and order history loaded from provided CSV files.
